description: Compute the D-axis fractional weight vector from a list of AccessReceipt records with role, timestamp, and content length. Returns canonical DataAxisEntry[] with 6-digit decimal contribution_weight strings that sum to ~1.0 and feed directly into aps_construct_attribution_primitive. Empty input → empty array; all-zero raw weights → error. Weights = role × recency_decay × length_weight, normalized per spec BUILD-B §'The D-axis formula'. Parameter names match the SDK: `sources`, `action_timestamp`, optional `profile`.

action_timestamp.description: ISO-8601 UTC ms when the action ran (t_action)

profile.description: Optional WeightProfile override; defaults to DEFAULT_WEIGHT_PROFILE

timestamp.description: ISO-8601 UTC with millisecond precision + Z (t_source)

name: aps_compute_data_axis_weights
